title: ARIA runtime signal record
description: One external runtime lead as aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_signal_bridge.py folds it (fold_runtime_signals) from its append-only events on <tools-root>/runtime-signals/events.jsonl (aria/runtime-signal-event/v1, ARIA-MEDIUM-271): the latest observation's fields, the episode the signal is in (a sighting after a resolve or a quarantine opens the next one) and the sightings counted in it. A lead is NEVER evidence: trust_grade is pinned to runtime_unverified and consumers must not repo-grade it. The enums here mirror the bridge's module constants; aria-kernel/tests/test_runtime_signal_connectors.py fails the suite when the two drift apart.

reported_severity.description: Present only when the bridge capped an outside-authored source's claimed severity (UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_SOURCES): the value the source reported, kept beside the bounded severity.

quarantine_reason.description: Why the signal was closed by a quarantined event: one of its refs fails the bridge's current ref law (canonical_runtime_signal_ref).

recorded_at.description: When the signal's current episode was first observed.

episode.description: 1 for the first episode; each sighting after a close opens the next.
